text:
maria: Quick pre-freeze check — planning a staged rollout for `r2.4.1` during the 03:00 UTC change window. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation between stages. Any objections?

sam: no objections, what are the concrete rollback triggers?

maria: rollback thresholds: error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline AND failing critical smoke tests. Also manual rollback allowed by release lead.

darren: we need to pin the embeddings model to `embed-3b-q8` for this release — otherwise customers on dedicated infra might get unexpected perf. Maria, can you confirm pin in rollout config?

maria: yes, pinned `embed-3b-q8` in the deploy manifest and documented in the release notes: https://internal.redwood.com/relnotes/r2.4.1 (internal link)

ben: adding that the database migration is zero-downtime but long-running — if replication lag > 5s during canary, we abort. Also make sure the migration feature flag `migrate_2026_03` is off for canary until smoke green.

maria: noted, will keep flag off at 5% and enable at 25% if smoke passes.

carla: who's owning the smoke checklist? I'll take it but need the exact commands and expected responses.

maria: Carla, here's the quick smoke script to run on canary instances: 

```
# check health endpoints
curl -sS https://canary-api.internal/health | jq .status  # expect "ok"
# sample generation
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-api.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .tokens  # expect >0
# embedding sanity
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-api.internal/embed -d '{"text":"test"}' | jq .length  # expect 1536 for embed-3b-q8
```

carla: got it, will run and post results.

deploy-bot: [automated] Scheduled rollout for `r2.4.1` accepted by CI: all checks passed. Canary policy: [5,25,100] minutes wait: 10. Notifying #eng-oncall.

sam: what's the monitoring playbook? which alerts auto-escalate vs page?

maria: auto-page if error-rate spike triggers SRE alert (pager). For p95 latency we get a slack warning at 0.25x threshold and page at 0.4x. All alerts are linked in the runbook: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/canary-monitoring

ben: small ask — keep rolling back window open for 30m after full rollout in case any delayed regressions.

maria: agree. We'll keep the freeze for 30m post-rollout.

carla: smoke results at 03:08 UTC after 5% canary:
- health: ok
- generate: tokens returned (sample ok)
- embed length: 1536
no errors seen in logs for canary hosts.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary at 5% complete — no automated abort conditions met. Proceeding to 25% in 10m.

sam: thumbs for proceeding :thumbsup: — I'm standing by for rollback command if needed.

maria: rollback runbook quick commands: `./deploy rollback --to r2.4.0 --force` (CI will require approver in prod), or use the deploy-bot slash command `/deploy rollback r2.4.0` for emergency.

darren: confirming embeddings pin applied to dedicated pools, saw manifest change in repo. :eyes:

carla: 25% smoke at 03:25 UTC looks clean. No errors, p95 within 5% of baseline. Enabling `migrate_2026_03` now for 25% traffic.

deploy-bot: [automated] 100% rollout started for `r2.4.1`. Post-rollout observation window: 30m.

ben: log retention check: adding a temporary log-export to S3 for post-rollout debugging (kept for 72h).

maria: final note — release notes updated with DB migration caveats, embedding pin, and config toggles. Thank you all.

deploy-bot: [automated] Full rollout of `r2.4.1` completed at 03:40 UTC. No aborts. Observability checks green.

carla: marking this thread as smoke-checked and handing back to release ops. Good launch :rocket:

sam: nice work team, keep monitoring for the 30m window.

maria: closing the freeze in ~30m if no regressions. Thanks.
